inShort: A drives at B from the baseline, a little harder each round, and B blocks every ball back without moving the feet.
rules: A stands at the baseline, B at the kitchen line across the net.
A drives every ball at B, like a third-shot drive. Start at about 60 % pace.
B blocks it back: paddle out in front, weight forward, no backswing.
B's feet stay where they are. A water bottle behind B's heels marks the line not to step back over.
After every 10 good blocks, A adds about 10 % pace, up to full pace.
tooEasy: A drives at full pace and mixes the target: body, left hip, right hip. Even harder: A moves up to midcourt, so B has less time.
tooHard: A stays at about 60 % and drives straight at B's paddle.
goodLooksLike: B's weight stays forward through contact, and the block comes back low over the net instead of popping up.
